quote.text: A man standing by a spring of clear, sweet water and cursing it. While the fresh water keeps on bubbling up. He can shovel mud into it, or dung, and the stream will carry it away, wash itself clean, remain unstained.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that just as clear water continues to flow pure despite attempts to taint it, a child's inherent goodness remains resilient even in the face of mistakes or external negativity.
    • Focus on nurturing and guiding, allowing your natural warmth and wisdom to wash away minor missteps, much like the spring cleanses itself without blame.
  • Leadership
    • Emulate the spring’s unwavering clarity by remaining steadfast in your vision despite distractions or disruptive influences, ensuring that your core values stay intact.
    • Allow challenges or criticism to serve as catalysts for growth, trusting that a well-grounded leader, like the bubbling stream, inherently cleanses and improves through continuous movement.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, remain focused on the core essence of your offering; even when obstacles or negative inputs attempt to muddy the path, the fundamental value endures and refines itself.
    • Embrace continual iteration and improvement, just as the spring naturally purifies the water—trust that quality and innovation will persist and shine through the challenges.
